blocks.text: Country ballad “Choosin’ Texas” from singer Ella Langley on Tuesday, Sept. 22, broke the record for most weeks topping the Billboard Hot 100 chart in the United States, unseating a famed Christmas song by Mariah Carey. The track was released in October and has been number one for 23 weeks in a ranking that includes streaming, radio play, sales and data, the magazine said, adding that its figures are tabulated by the company Luminate. Langley, 27, thus surpasses American legend Carey’s Christmas anthem “All I Want for Christmas Is You.” In a video posted to Instagram on Tuesday, the Alabama native […]...
